staggered.commit_hold_on: accepted fpComplete or accepted exceptional systemComplete, once per token tag

bounds_justification.explanation: Abort caps, not measured performance. After ten real fflags clears, request scaling estimates 156000-162000 cycles; 180000 adds roughly 11-15 percent margin. Prior trace density of 109.115 bytes/cycle projects 19.64 MB at the cycle cap, leaving approximately 3.43 MB under 22 MiB. Native timeout remains 120 seconds and aggregate batch cap remains 512 MiB. Scalar fetch uses lane zero; no throughput claim.
